title: Punjab Government Educational and Training Institutions Amendment Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: Punjab Government Educational and Training Institutions Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PUNJAB GOVERNMENT EDUCATIONAL AND TRAINING INSTITUTIONS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2002
PUNJAB GOVERNMENT EDUCATIONAL AND TRAINING INSTITUTIONS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXVI OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Punjab Government Educational and Training Institutions,
Ordinance, 1960
[Gazette of
Punjab, Extraordinary, 25th June, 2002]
No.Legis.13-27/2002, dated
25-6-2002.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Punjab Government Educational
and Training Institutions (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
